findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler can no longer be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data). Python will raise TypeError when Detector.detector_handler tries to instantiate it via group_type.detector_handler(self). Previously it implemented evaluate() and returned [], so process_detectors could handle it; now processing a metric-alert detector will crash process_detectors instead of being skipped or producing no results.

findings.title: Occurrence tests do not verify the evaluated value passed to the hook
findings.body: build_mock_occurrence_and_event ignores its value argument when constructing the IssueOccurrence and event_data, so tests cannot detect evaluate_group_key_value passing the wrong value to build_occurrence_and_event_data. This is visible here: group_2 has packet value 10 but the expected occurrence is built with value 6, and the assertion still passes. A regression passing e.g. the dedupe value or another group's value would go uncaught.
